thread:
maria: Quick design review: proposing a small countdown badge after users hit Stop so they know how long "saved state" is available. Want feedback on visuals + copy.
ethan: Nice. UX Q: does countdown appear on the message or in the composer?
maria: On the message tail, right beside the tokens/pill. Shows after Stop: "Saved  00:30" where 00:30 is the TTL countdown.
lina: Visual suggestion: fade from green->amber->red as TTL approaches 0. Keep motion subtle.
agnes: Accessibility: make sure color isn't the only signal; add text like "Saved for 30s" and a sr-only live region update. Also Stop must remain reachable via keyboard (Esc).
samir: Backend note: default TTL 30s is fine. We should expose 30/60 server-side knobs. Also important: Continue must reuse KV; Regenerate must purge KV immediately.
maria: Copy suggestion: after stop show two actions: "Continue stream" and "Regenerate reply". The count badge tooltip says "Saved generation state for 30s".
olivia: Prompt library: prefer a right sidesheet (not modal) so inserting doesn't steal focus. Insert should put text at cursor and show an "Undo insert" toast for 5s.
ethan: Mobile: collapse the badge to an icon only, tap expands to show countdown and actions. Touch target >=44px.
agnes: SR announcement examples:
"Generation paused. Saved for 30 seconds. Press Continue to resume or Regenerate to restart."
"Generation resumed."
maria: Rate-limit live token updates to 200ms to reduce redraws. Show live-token only while streaming; replace with final token total on completion. No estimated final.
samir: Agreed on 200ms. I'll check impact on telemetry and batching.
lina: Microcopy tweak: use verbs consistently: "Stop stream", "Continue stream", "Regenerate reply", "Undo insert".
olivia: I'll collect these strings and add them to the copy doc.
ethan: Quick accessibility nit: ensure the pulsing indicator has reduced-motion alternative.
agnes: (typo) -- agnes: Also ensure contrast for countdown text meets AA.
maria: Action items: Ethan -> mock badge states (normal/fading/expired + mobile compact). Agnes -> aria snippets & reduced-motion notes. Samir -> perf check for 30s/60s TTL and 200ms update. Olivia -> finalize copy bundle. Lina -> animation polish. Reconvene after mocks in ~48h
